name: Flower Mound
seo_title: Flower Mound Christmas Parade and Events, TX 2026
seo_description: Flower Mound Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting Dec 5, Lakeside Village tree lighting Dec 2 and Breakfast with Santa Dec 12, with local Christmas history.
lede: The story of Christmas in Flower Mound begins with a fifty-foot mound of Indian paintbrush that gave the town its name soon after settlers arrived in 1844. Today the season centers on the Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting at Gerault Park and a tree lighting at Lakeside Village.
sections: A mound of paintbrush and a town since 1844

The Handbook of Texas says Flower Mound was established soon after Sam Houston settled a tribal dispute in 1844. The Peters colony named the town for a fifty-foot-high mound covered with Indian paintbrush. Grapevine Lake, completed on July 2, 1953, drew new residents, and the town incorporated on February 27, 1961. In the 1970s a federal plan for Flower Mound New Town, meant to house 60,000 to 70,000 people, failed, and HUD foreclosed in 1976. Flower Mound grew from 4,402 people in 1980 to 50,702 in 2000.
The Gibson-Grant Log House and Old Settlers Christmas

William Gibson, a Peters colonist, brought his family to the Republic of Texas in 1844 and settled in what the town's historic structure report calls Long Prairie. The Town of Flower Mound acquired the property in 2015 and named the Gibson-Grant Log House for Gibson and for developer Curtis Grant, who discovered the old structure when he planned to demolish the house. The Town's Historical Commission hosted Old Settlers Christmas there, with butter churning and corn shucking. The town calendar now lists the December 12, 2026 date as canceled.

DCTA's A-train station list has no Flower Mound stop. Its stations are in Denton, Lewisville and Carrollton. For a Christmas train, the Grapevine Vintage Railroad runs Santa's North Pole Express from the Historic Cotton Belt District, with sing-alongs led by Santa's elves Holly and Frosty and a visit from Santa Claus. The 2026 dates include November 29, December 1, December 5 and many days through December 29. For more train history, the Museum of the American Railroad in Frisco and the Interurban Railway Museum in Plano are a drive away.

traditions: The Town lights its tree at Gerault Park on Saturday, December 5, 2026, with festivities from 5:30 pm and the theme A Star-Spangled Christmas.
The Lakeside Village tree lights up at 7:30 pm on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, with Magen Miller playing from 6:30 pm.
The Town's Parks and Recreation department serves a pancake breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 8 to 10:30 am, with registration required.
The Historical Commission's frontier Christmas at the Gibson-Grant Log House, with butter churning and corn shucking, is marked canceled for 2026.
The street event that would have marked its 10th year is on hiatus in 2026 and is planned to return in 2027.
kidfact: Flower Mound is named for a mound fifty feet high that was covered with Indian paintbrush flowers when settlers first saw it.
faq: How did Flower Mound get its name?

The Handbook of Texas says the Peters colony named the town for a fifty-foot-high mound covered with Indian paintbrush. The mound had once been used as a holy place. Settlers arrived soon after 1844, drawn by soil good for cotton, corn and wheat, and the town incorporated on February 27, 1961.
When is the Flower Mound Christmas parade in 2026?

The Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting Ceremony is Saturday, December 5, 2026, at Gerault Park, 1200 Gerault Road, with festivities beginning at 5:30 pm. The Town's calendar lists 5:30 to 9 pm, and the parade entry form lists the parade at 6 pm. The theme is A Star-Spangled Christmas.
Is Old Settlers Christmas happening in 2026?

No. The Town of Flower Mound calendar now reads CANCELED: Old Settlers Christmas for Saturday, December 12, 2026. The event was hosted by the Town's Historical Commission at the Gibson-Grant Log House, with butter churning and corn shucking. Breakfast with Santa is still listed the same morning.
Is the Lakeside Village Holiday Event happening in 2026?

No. Lakeside Village says the large holiday street event takes a hiatus in 2026 because of manpower limits, and it plans to bring the tradition back in 2027. The Christmas tree lighting and Lakeside Music Series still go ahead on Wednesday, December 2, with music at 6:30 pm and the lights at 7:30 pm.
What is the Gibson-Grant Log House?

It is a historic log house on land first settled by William Gibson, a Peters colonist who arrived in 1844. Developer Curtis Grant found the old structure while planning to demolish the house, and the Town of Flower Mound acquired the property in 2015 and named it for both men.
Are there Christmas train rides near Flower Mound?

Flower Mound has no DCTA A-train stop. Grapevine runs Santa's North Pole Express on the Grapevine Vintage Railroad from the Historic Cotton Belt District, with 2026 dates from November 29 through December 29 and ticketed departure times listed by the Grapevine visitors bureau.
